args:
ver=0.1.11
for c in "$1" "$2" "$3"; do
  case "$c" in
    ""|\$*) ;;
    *) if [ -x "$c/bin/developer-observability" ]; then shift 3; exec "$c/bin/developer-observability" "$@"; fi ;;
  esac
done
for v in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT"; do
  case "$v" in
    ""|\$*) ;;
    *) if [ -x "$v/bin/developer-observability" ]; then shift 3; exec "$v/bin/developer-observability" "$@"; fi ;;
  esac
done
if [ -n "$HOME" ]; then
  for launcher in "$HOME"/.cursor/plugins/cache/*/developer-observability/"$ver"/bin/developer-observability "$HOME"/.cursor/plugins/cache/*/developer-observability/*/bin/developer-observability; do
    if [ -x "$launcher" ]; then shift 3; exec "$launcher" "$@"; fi
  done
fi
echo "developer-observability: PLUGIN_ROOT_UNRESOLVED: no plugin root variable expanded and no cached copy found; reinstall the plugin from its marketplace" >&2
exit 127
